entries.risk: A tool URL selected from mutable or candidate-controlled data could turn the QA image build into an unintended outbound request.

entries.removalCondition: Remove this entry if download endpoints become compile-time constants or CodeQL can model trusted-control provenance.
entries.targetAction: Keep CI build inputs trusted-control-bound and all downloads exact-digest-verified; any source drift requires renewed review.
